attacks.description: Attacker registers identical land with a different salt under pre-A0 nullifier, dodging nullification
Unconstrained vintage string allows relabeling vintage (e.g. '2024-A', '2024-B') or claiming arbitrary future vintages
Two registries register the same land parcel (`geohash8`) and issue duplicate credits for the same vintage year
attacks.mechanism: Global Geospatial Nullifier (`issuanceNullifier := keccak256(geohash8, vintageYear, creditType)`)

attacks.description: Operator attempts to re-issue credits for an already credited plot and vintage in the same registry
Attacker generates fresh salt2 for same parcel (geohash8) to create new `geoCommitment` and issue duplicate credits
attacks.mechanism: Salt-Independent Nullifier (`keccak256(geohash8, vintageYear, creditType)` asserts parcel unicity regardless of salt)

attacks.description: Claimant replays an identical retirement parameter set to claim multiple ESG / Scope 1 offsets against the same tokens
attacks.mechanism: Global Claim Nullifier (`claimNullifier := keccak256(issuanceNullifier, claimant, claimType, beneficiaryCommitment)`)

attacks.description: Retirement transaction targeting a non-existent serial batch identifier
attacks.mechanism: Monotonic Batch Registry & Strict Existence Check (`serialId <= totalBatches`)

attacks.description: Claiming 644 tCO2e when the verified satellite MRV model output only justifies 544 tCO2e

attacks.attack: Credit-Type Relabel or Future Vintage Year
attacks.description: Relabeling credit type or setting unverified future vintage year (`vintageYear > currentYear`)
attacks.mechanism: Strict Range Check (`2000 <= vintageYear <= currentYear`) & Enum Bounds
